extraction.document_summary: AIA Centurion PA is a personal accident insurance plan designed for “golden years”, offering worldwide coverage for accidental death, accidental injury, accidental disability and specified accident-related events. It has three basic benefit levels (Plan 1/Plan 2/Plan 3) with coverage amounts such as Accidental Death of S$30,000 / S$60,000 / S$100,000 and Accidental Medical Reimbursement of S$1,000 / S$2,000 / S$3,000. It also provides daily accidental hospital income (S$50 / S$100 / S$150), plus home-care and mobility/medical-related reimbursement amounts. Most benefits (except benefit #9, #12 and #13) are reduced by 50% from the policy anniversary on or after age 81. Coverage starts at age 40 up to age 80 (last birthday) and is described as continuing “till age 100”, with “guaranteed acceptance” described as “no health questions asked”. The optional Dementia Benefit adds multi-stage dementia coverage (Option 1/2/3) with early/intermediate paying 50% once and major stage paying 100% less the early/intermediate payout, for eligible dementia types until age 85.
quality_notes: Brochure provides plan tables with explicit coverage amounts and an optional dementia section with stage mechanics.
Some operational terms (e.g., exact benefit triggers/definition wording, renewal terms, and full exclusions) are not present beyond high-level notes and caveats.

policies.quick_summary: Personal accident insurance with worldwide coverage for accidental death/injury/disability and accident-related medical/reimbursement benefits, offered in Basic Plans 1–3, plus an optional multi-stage Dementia Benefit with reimbursement and stage-based payout mechanics (Early & Intermediate vs Major stage). Entry is described as age 40 to 80 (last birthday) with coverage “till age 100”, and “Guaranteed acceptance” is described as no health questions asked for the base plan. Most benefits reduce by 50% from policy anniversary on or after age 81 (except certain benefits). Public documentation lists multiple benefit amounts per plan tier.
policies.eligibility_notes: Last entry age to add on optional Dementia Benefit is 70 years old (last birthday).
policies.coverage_term_description: Brochure states coverage can be started from age 40 to as high as 80 years old and for protection till age 100; ages 81+ at last birthday apply to renewals only (per terms).
policies.renewal_basis: Ages 81 at last birthday and above apply to renewals only.
important_caveats: Most benefits (except benefit #9, #12 and #13) will be reduced by 50% from the policy anniversary on or after your 81st birthday.
Value-added services provided by partners are not contractual benefits and may be cancelled/withdrawn at AIA’s discretion.
Value-added teleconsultation fee excludes GST/medication/delivery/tests where applicable.
